method: CSV export of the official VoteWA candidate list (ASP.NET postback), election GENERAL 2026, county State
manual_export_steps: Election dropdown: choose 'GENERAL 2026 (11/03/2026) (General)' (option value 899); the page posts back
County dropdown: choose 'State' (option value 99); the page posts back. Equivalent direct URL: https://voter.votewa.gov/candidatelist.aspx?c=99&e=899

Click the grid's 'Export to CSV' icon (input ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$grdCandidates$ctl00$ctl02$ctl00$ExportToCsvButton); the response is text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment;filename="CandidateList.csv"
scripted_export: Reproduced non-interactively on 2026-10-08 with Python urllib + a cookie jar: GET the direct URL, then POST the form back to its action ('./candidatelist.aspx?c=99&e=899') replaying every hidden input (including __VIEWSTATE__, __VIEWSTATE, __EVENTVALIDATION and the Telerik ClientState fields) and every <select> (selected option, or the first option when none is marked selected; ctl00$ddlLanguages must be 'en-us' or the server returns its generic error page), plus the field ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$grdCandidates$ctl00$ctl02$ctl00$ExportToCsvButton=' '.

ballot_order_source.note: The CSV export omits the grid's 'Ballot Order' column. Ballot order for the Supreme Court rows was read from the HTML grid, page 3 of 3 (100 rows per page), reached by posting back __EVENTTARGET=ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$grdCandidates$ctl00$ctl03$ctl01$ctl09 with the same form replay.

notes: Official statewide candidate filing data for the November 3, 2026 general. 269 rows: 20 Congressional, 225 Legislative, 24 Judicial (10 Supreme Court rows for Justice Positions #01, #03, #04, #05, #07; the rest Court of Appeals and multi-county Superior Court). The 'Election Status' column is blank for every row in this export. Used as state-level provenance for the statewide Supreme Court contests.
